name: SpanContext
docs:
Immutable portion of a [`Span`] which can be serialized and propagated.

This representation conforms to the [W3C TraceContext specification].

Spans that do not have the `sampled` flag set in their [`TraceFlags`] will
be ignored by most tracing tools.

[`Span`]: crate::trace::Span
[W3C TraceContext specification]: https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context
availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.
